slides.title: Three extra letters
slides.body:
*Å*, *ä* and *ö* aren't a and o with decorations. They are separate letters with their own sounds.

They come last in the Swedish alphabet: x, y, z, *å*, *ä*, *ö*.

slides.en: The cabin is by a stream.

caption:
In Swedish, å is a whole word: a stream. Ö is a word too: an island. And i means in.

Å, ä and ö are separate letters, not decorated versions of a and o, and they come at the very end of the alphabet.

Which one is hardest for you to say?
